## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Impact

Describe user, developer, operational, API, data, or security impact.

## Validation

- [ ] Build completed.
- [ ] Automated tests completed.
- [ ] Frontend syntax check completed when applicable.
- [ ] Functional smoke review completed when applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated.
- [ ] No runtime data, real inventory, credentials, or secrets are included.

List commands, environment, results, and evidence:

## Pre-Deployment Gates

- [ ] Acceptance
- [ ] Unit
- [ ] Properties and invariants
- [ ] Mutation
- [ ] Fuzzing
- [ ] Integration
- [ ] Contract
- [ ] End-to-end
- [ ] Regression
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Concurrency and resilience
- [ ] Performance and resources
- [ ] Compatibility and deployment

Document any unavailable gate with its reason, risk, compensating control, and
project-owner approval. A merged pull request is not by itself deployment
approval.
